education_path.after_shs: A BSc in the science (or HND for technician roles), then a master's or PhD for research positions.

ghana_institutions: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology

careers.title: Environmental Scientist
careers.description: Environmental scientists study pollution, land, water and climate and advise on protecting the environment.

education_path.after_shs: A BSc in the science (or HND for technician roles), then a master's or PhD for research positions.

ghana_institutions: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology

careers.title: Laboratory Technician
careers.description: Lab technicians prepare samples and equipment and run tests in school, research and industry labs.

education_path.after_shs: A BSc in the science (or HND for technician roles), then a master's or PhD for research positions.

careers.title: Nuclear Scientist
careers.description: Nuclear scientists use radiation and nuclear techniques in medicine, agriculture, industry and energy, safely.

education_path.after_shs: A BSc in the science (or HND for technician roles), then a master's or PhD for research positions.

careers.title: Airline Pilot
careers.description: Pilots fly aircraft safely carrying passengers or cargo, following strict procedures and weather planning.

education_path.after_shs: Flight training at an approved flight school to earn pilot licences from the civil aviation authority; a science or engineering background helps.

careers.title: Air Traffic Controller
careers.description: Air traffic controllers guide aircraft safely on the ground and in the air using radar and radio.

education_path.after_shs: Selection and training by the civil aviation authority's training academy after SHS or a degree.

careers.title: Aircraft Maintenance Engineer
careers.description: Aircraft maintenance engineers inspect and repair aircraft engines, structures and systems so every flight is safe.

education_path.after_shs: An approved aircraft maintenance training programme leading to a licence, or an aerospace or mechanical engineering degree.

careers.title: Ship Officer / Navigator
careers.description: Ship officers navigate and manage merchant ships, cargo and crew safety at sea.

education_path.after_shs: A nautical science programme at a maritime university, with sea time to earn officer licences.

careers.title: Port and Shipping Officer
careers.description: Port officers manage the movement of ships and containers, cargo documents and port operations.

education_path.after_shs: A degree or diploma in port and shipping management or logistics.

careers.title: Transport Planner
careers.description: Transport planners design road, rail and public transport systems that move people and goods efficiently.

education_path.after_shs: A degree in planning, civil engineering or geography, then a master's in transport planning.

ghana_institutions: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology

careers.description: Professional drivers carry passengers and goods safely; driving instructors teach new drivers.

education_path.after_shs: A driving licence of the right class from the licensing authority, a defensive driving course and experience.

careers.title: Railway Technician / Engineer
careers.description: Railway engineers and technicians build and maintain tracks, signals and trains.

education_path.after_shs: A degree in civil, mechanical or electrical engineering, or an HND/TVET programme in a related trade.

education_path.after_shs: A degree or doctorate in audiology, then registration with the Allied Health Professions Council.

careers.description: Prosthetists and orthotists design and fit artificial limbs and supportive braces so people can move and work.

education_path.after_shs: Training in prosthetics and orthotics, then registration with the Allied Health Professions Council.
